text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The historic Tenno Sho (Spring). It will 
surely serve as the stage to carve your 
name as a hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The insecure girl from her debut race is 
no more. With firm and steady strides, she 
heads out onto the turf.
